meta.label: Gemma 4
meta.description: Gemma 4 models on Vertex AI Model Garden using dedicated or private PSC endpoints.

params.name: model_variant
params.label: Model variant
params.description: Select the deployed Gemma 4 variant. Instruction-tuned (IT) uses structured chat completions; Base / pretrained uses plain-text completions. The plugin automatically selects the corresponding Vertex AI request format.

params.name: endpoint_type
params.label: Endpoint type
params.description: Select how this connection routes requests: Private Service Connect (PSC) uses a private endpoint with the plugin-level PSC address; Dedicated uses Vertex AI's dedicated endpoint routing.

params.name: endpoint_id
params.label: Vertex Endpoint ID
params.description: Vertex AI endpoint identifier for this model connection (do not use the Dataiku model name).

params.name: max_tokens
params.label: Max output tokens
params.description: Maximum number of tokens generated by the model. Applies to both Base and Instruction-tuned variants.
